subsections.content: Machinery HOF GmbH ("Company," "we," or "us") uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website machineryhofgmbh.com ("Website") to enhance user experience, analyze website performance, and support marketing efforts.
This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, which cookies we use, and how you can control them.
Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit our Website. They serve to remember information about your visit and preferences.
Similar technologies include:
Strictly Necessary Cookies

details.description: These cookies are essential for the Website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and compliance with legal requirements. These cookies cannot be disabled.
details.examples: Session cookies, security tokens, CSRF protection

subsections.content: Performance Cookies

details.description: These cookies help us understand how users interact with our Website by collecting anonymous information about page visits, user behavior, and device information.

subsections.content: Preference Cookies

details.description: These cookies remember your preferences and settings to provide a more personalized experience on future visits.
details.examples: Language preference, website theme, display preferences

subsections.content: Marketing Cookies

details.description: These cookies are used to track visitors across websites to display targeted advertising and marketing content. They may be set by third-party advertising partners.
details.examples: Retargeting pixels, conversion tracking, audience identification

subsections.content: The following table lists the main cookies used on our Website:

cookies.name: _ga, _gid, _gat
cookies.purpose: Google Analytics - tracks user behavior and website performance

cookies.name: CSRF token
cookies.purpose: Protects against cross-site request forgery attacks

subsections.content: We use third-party services that may set their own cookies on your device:
These third parties have their own privacy policies governing their cookie use. We recommend reviewing their policies at their respective websites.
We use cookies for the following purposes:
list: Enabling core website functionality and security
Analyzing website traffic and user behavior
Measuring the effectiveness of marketing campaigns

subsections.content: We obtain your consent for non-essential cookies through a cookie banner displayed when you first visit our Website. You can:
You can manage cookies through your browser settings:
browserOptions: Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or alert you when a cookie is being sent
You can delete existing cookies from your browser
You can set your browser to block third-party cookies

subsections.content: Please note that disabling cookies may affect Website functionality and user experience.
You can opt out of specific cookie types:

optOutOptions.description: Opt out of Google Analytics tracking
Opt out of interest-based advertising via NAI Opt-Out

subsections.content: You can also use the Cookie Preference Center on our Website to adjust your settings at any time.
Cookies may contain or result in the processing of personal data. Please refer to our Privacy Policy for information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
Some browsers include a "Do Not Track" feature. Our Website does not currently respond to Do Not Track signals, as there is no industry standard for recognizing such signals.

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our cookie practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our Website with an updated "Last Updated" date.
